derive_TyperBase_subclass: derive from TyperBase and implement _compute_type_inputs_known to compute types for BMG nodes
get_cached_type_with_getitem: use the bracket accessor on a TyperBase instance to get or compute the cached type of a BMG node
check_type_cached_with_contains: use the in operator on a TyperBase instance to check if a BMG node type is already cached
update_type_and_propagate: call update_type on a TyperBase instance to recompute a node type and propagate changes to descendants
check_inputs_known: call _inputs_known on a TyperBase instance to check if all input nodes of a BMG node are already typed
